diagram_math_checks.justification: Differentiating step 1.1 gives X_xi=1-t sech^2(xi). Since 0<sech^2(xi)<=1 with equality exactly at xi=0, no derivative vanishes for 0<=t<1 and X_xi(1,0)=0 as step 2.1 states. Also X(1,0)=0. This matches the local caustic definition, which allows rank loss without asserting distinct samples meet at t=1.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The xi=+/-1 projections meet at x=0,t=coth(1)>1, while the lifted paths remain distinct.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Solve -1+t tanh(1)=1-t tanh(1); the result is t=1/tanh(1)=1.313035285..., drawn at 1.313035. Their heights +/-tanh(1) are nonzero and unequal. These identities follow from step 1.1 and the graphing distinction in def-characteristic-crossing-and-caustic-for-first-order-pde.
